chunks: Saʿdān narrated from Abī Baṣīr, from Abī ʿAbdِ اللَّهِ عليه السلام, who said:
He should not marry a Jewish woman or a Christian woman alongside a free woman, whether as mutʿah or otherwise.

key_terms.حُرَّةٍ: a free woman, as opposed to a bondwoman
key_terms.غَيْرَ مُتْعَةٍ: other than temporary marriage, i.e. non-mutʿah marriage

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to marry a Jewish or Christian woman alongside a free woman in mutʿah or permanent marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning marriage arrangements involving a free woman and a Jewish or Christian woman. It states that such a marriage is not to be contracted alongside a free woman, whether in mutʿah (temporary marriage) or other than mutʿah.
